summary: Block 15B is part of the undeveloped Block 15 at UCSF's Mission Bay North Campus, which UCSF's Long Range Development Plan designates for housing (the 2014 plan's environmental review analysed housing and a relocated child care facility there). UCSF's June 2025 presentation lists it among the 'undeveloped parcels remaining' and says UCSF has 'no building plans at Mission Bay right now'; no project, developer or date is stated in any source found.

milestones.text: UC Regents certify the 2014 Long Range Development Plan Environmental Impact Report (November 20, 2014) and approve the plan; the report analysed new housing and a relocated child care facility on Block 15 (as recounted in the 2017 addenda). UCSF's documents name the block 'Block 15' without an A/B split

UCSF's September 13, 2016 Note to File analysed temporary contractor parking on Blocks 15 and 16 (recounted in Addendum #4); a separate September 26, 2016 notice covers wet-utility piping and surface work 'in and adjacent to' Blocks 14, 15, 16 and 18
UCSF's Mission Bay CAC presentation lists 'Block 15 – Housing' among undeveloped parcels remaining 'per UCSF's Long Range Development Plan', and states 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now'

facts.value: Housing (UCSF June 2025 presentation, citing its Long Range Development Plan); the 2014 plan's environmental review also analysed a relocated child care facility on Block 15

None stated for this block. UCSF's June 12, 2025 Mission Bay CAC presentation says 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now'; the only date in it, 'After 2035', is attached to South Campus Phase 2 (hospital, parking), not to this block
OCII's December 2019 Mission Bay Land Use Map labels Block 15 as two parcels, 15A and 15B; UCSF's own documents read use 'Block 15' as one block

open_questions: No source found states when Block 15 housing will be built, who will build it, how many units, or whether it is student, faculty or other housing: UCSF's June 2025 deck only lists the use and says it has no building plans at Mission Bay right now.

The 2014 Long Range Development Plan document itself (the UCSF Real Estate and Campus Planning pages) could not be opened here (the sites returned a block page); the plan's use for Block 15 is taken from UCSF's June 2025 deck and from the 2017 addenda's recital of the 2014 environmental report.
The A/B split: only OCII's land use map separates 15A from 15B; no source read says how the planned housing divides between them.
OCII's December 2019 Mission Bay Land Use Map labels this parcel; its colour legend has a 'UCSF' category (the map's colour fill is graphic, not text, so the use shown there was not read as text).
Current ground conditions (parked cars noted in the geometry file's notes) come from aerial imagery, not a document, and are not asserted here.
